subject: 096cf6e7-e3cb-42a8-9c2d-c58574b7e8e7
object: Northern Irish physicist (1928–1990).  His 1964 theorem transformed the Bohr-Einstein debate from philosophy into experimental physics.  Worked at CERN.  Died of a cerebral hemorrhage at 62, just as his work was being recognized as one of the most profound results in physics.
